item.title: In Mexico, journalists face threats from attackers — and from the system meant to protect them, too
item.description: Created in 2012, Mexico’s Protection Mechanism for Human Rights Defenders and Journalists has struggled to guarantee the safety of those it was designed to protect, operating largely in response to attacks rather than preventing them.

item.title: Pope Leo returns to beloved former home of Chiclayo, the Peruvian city that claims him as its own
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is celebrated in Chiclayo, Peru, where his image is ubiquitous. Known for his social justice work, he served as bishop from 2015 to 2023.

item.title: 5 years of fighting climate change haven't done much and stronger targets are needed, report says
item.description: A report says the world has failed to slow or stop global warming trends in the past five years because plans weren’t realized and efforts that would have helped were canceled out.
